디모데전서 1:1.content: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the commandment of God our Saviour, and Lord Jesus Christ, which is our hope;

디모데전서 1:2.content: Unto Timothy, my own son in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God our Father and Jesus Christ our Lord.

디모데전서 1:3.content: As I besought thee to abide still at Ephesus, when I went into Macedonia, that thou mightest charge some that they teach no other doctrine,

디모데전서 1:4.content: Neither give heed to fables and endless genealogies, which minister questions, rather than godly edifying which is in faith: so do.

디모데전서 1:5.content: Now the end of the commandment is charity out of a pure heart, and of a good conscience, and of faith unfeigned:

디모데전서 1:6.content: From which some having swerved have turned aside unto vain jangling;

디모데전서 1:7.content: Desiring to be teachers of the law; understanding neither what they say, nor whereof they affirm.

디모데전서 1:8.content: But we know that the law is good, if a man use it lawfully;

디모데전서 1:9.content: Knowing this, that the law is not made for a righteous man, but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and for sinners, for unholy and profane, for murderers of fathers and murderers of mothers, for manslayers,

디모데전서 1:10.content: For whoremongers, for them that defile themselves with mankind, for menstealers, for liars, for perjured persons, and if there be any other thing that is contrary to sound doctrine;

디모데전서 1:11.content: According to the glorious gospel of the blessed God, which was committed to my trust.

디모데전서 1:12.content: And I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who hath enabled me, for that he counted me faithful, putting me into the ministry;

디모데전서 1:13.content: Who was before a blasphemer, and a persecutor, and injurious: but I obtained mercy, because I did it ignorantly in unbelief.

디모데전서 1:14.content: And the grace of our Lord was exceeding abundant with faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.

디모데전서 1:15.content: This is a faithful saying, and worthy of all acceptation, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners; of whom I am chief.

디모데전서 1:16.content: Howbeit for this cause I obtained mercy, that in me first Jesus Christ might shew forth all longsuffering, for a pattern to them which should hereafter believe on him to life everlasting.

디모데전서 1:17.content: Now unto the King eternal, immortal, invisible, the only wise God, be honour and glory for ever and ever. Amen.

디모데전서 1:18.content: This charge I commit unto thee, son Timothy, according to the prophecies which went before on thee, that thou by them mightest war a good warfare;

디모데전서 1:19.content: Holding faith, and a good conscience; which some having put away concerning faith have made shipwreck:

디모데전서 1:20.content: Of whom is Hymeneus and Alexander; whom I have delivered unto Satan, that they may learn not to blaspheme.
